info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Streaming Subscriptions Devices-v1-spec
info.description: The Streaming Subscriptions Devices API enables users to access and list devices that are currently subscribed to streaming services. This endpoint is essential for developers who need to manage and monitor connected devices. Typical use cases include retrieving information for analytics, troubleshooting device connections, and ensuring optimal service delivery. This API streamlines the process of tracking device subscriptions within a streaming environment, enhancing the overall user experience.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of devices subscribed to the service.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all devices that are currently subscribed to the service, providing detailed information on each device's status and attributes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve a list of devices subscribed to the service. It should contain the necessary parameters in JSON format to filter or customize the response as needed.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of devices.
